name: Salsomaggiore Terme (Italy)
description: Blue field with a yellow border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Salsomaggiore Terme (a burning salt pan on blue) in a yellow cartouche within branches.
history: Municipal flag of Salsomaggiore Terme, a comune in Emilia-Romagna; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: Salsomaggiore Terme arms — burning salt pan on blue, crowned, in a cartouche within branches
